question: For each distinct mailing list containing more than 1000 people and with a name starting with A (case insensitive), provide its name, whether it is a mailing list, whether it is a moira group, whether it is a NFS group, the owner of the mailing list, and the number of people in the list.

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_lists" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_name" AS "moira_list_name", "is_moira_mailing_list" AS "is_moira_mailing_list", "is_moira_group" AS "is_moira_group", "is_nfs_group" AS "is_nfs_group" FROM beaver."moira_list";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_members" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_owner_key" AS "moira_list_owner_key", "moira_list_member" AS "moira_list_member", "moira_list_member_mit_id" AS "moira_list_member_mit_id" FROM beaver."moira_list_detail";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_owners" AS SELECT "moira_list_owner_key" AS "moira_list_owner_key", "owner" AS "owner", "owner_type" AS "owner_type" FROM beaver."moira_list_owner";

    CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
    WITH base AS (
        SELECT 
            ml.moira_list_key,
            ml.moira_list_name,
            ml.is_moira_mailing_list,
            ml.is_moira_group,
            ml.is_nfs_group
        FROM mailing_lists ml
        WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(ml.moira_list_name, '')) LIKE 'a%'
    ),
    joined AS (
        SELECT 
            b.moira_list_name AS list_name,
            CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(b.is_moira_mailing_list, 'N')) = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_mailing_list,
            CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(b.is_moira_group, 'N')) = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_moira_group,
            CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(b.is_nfs_group, 'N')) = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_nfs_group,
            o.owner AS owner,
            mc.member_count
        FROM base b
        LEFT JOIN _tmp_member_counts mc
          ON mc.moira_list_key = b.moira_list_key
        LEFT JOIN mailing_list_owners o
          ON o.moira_list_owner_key = mc.any_owner_key
    )
    SELECT 
        list_name,
        is_mailing_list,
        is_moira_group,
        is_nfs_group,
        owner,
        member_count
    FROM joined
    WHERE COALESCE(member_count, 0) > 1000
    ORDER BY member_count DESC, list_name ASC
